Tests batch bytes extraction with per-input config (extract_batch)

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { extractBatch } from "@xberg-io/xberg-wasm";
async function main() {
  const result = await extractBatch([{ bytes: "pdf/fake_memo.pdf", config: { outputFormat: "markdown" }, filename: "fake_memo.pdf", kind: "bytes" }], undefined);
  console.log(result.results[0].mimeType);
  console.log(result.results[0].content);
  console.log(result.results[0].metadata.outputFormat);
}

void main();
```
